submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Repaint ONE new independent run/NE/07 game animation frame from EDIT TARGET image1. Images2 portrait identity,3 NE idle orientation,4 approved painted style. Keep exact target head/face/body/prop pixel sizes, fixed full-canvas camera and root center. NE means rear-three-quarter running AWAY to upper-right, back of head and back costume visible, no visible frontal eyes/face. Do not turn into side-E or frontal-SE.
The camera-near anatomical RIGHT shoulder connects to RIGHT hand holding exactly FIVE red/gold rectangular flame talismans. Camera-far anatomical LEFT shoulder connects LEFT hand holding one bronze bell/red tassel. Trace both shoulder-elbow-wrist-hand chains, arms swing opposite to legs; do not simply switch props between screen sides. Exactly two arms/hands and two articulated legs/shoes, no third cuff, secure fingers on handles/card bases. Preserve five fan panels, no sixth sliver.
PHASE: Descending from brief flight. Far LEFT thigh is the lead leg pointing upper-right, left knee opening, LEFT foot reaches down toward its upcoming landing only about15px above the invisible ground plane. Near RIGHT trailing leg folds at knee, heel rises toward rump and its sole faces partly back to viewer at lower-left, clearly airborne. Pelvis descends naturally. Near RIGHT fan hand swings forward upper-right beside flank; far LEFT bell arm swings back lower-left, upper arm partly hidden. Avoid showing BOTH feet as equally dangling; lead LEFT shoe approaches plane with a shallow landing angle.
Hold the NE target's whole-canvas framing, apparent skull size, costume design and ground reference, root x512 and virtual near ground around y920 at1024; perspective far foot may appear slightly higher than near foot. Movement of knees/hips causes modest head/pelvis bob, not resizing or moving a flat cutout. Preserve brown high ponytail ruby crown, rear waist knot, short red-gold flame robe, black trousers and red-black-gold shoes. Robe, ribbon and bell tassel trail travel naturally. Show actual contact/absorption/push-off where specified, not perpetual flying.
Single square native >=1024 RGBA sprite, transparent background. No floor, shadows, glow, particles, text, grid or labels. Bright clean rounded richly hand-painted Taoist chibi style. No mirror, copied pose, warp, frame interpolation or contact sheet.
